parent_objective: smoke test corrected reset and current-tiled runtime controls before training
blocked_by: M1203 implements corrected control plumbing but no runtime smoke artifact has been written
supersedes: assuming focused unit tests are enough before corrected pilot rerun
invalidates: running corrected PPO pilot without a no-training runtime smoke

public_gates: M1204 may run no-training runtime smoke only
M1204 must not run candidate replay
M1204 must not use private holdout
M1204 must not claim profile superiority or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a no-training smoke proving corrected reset and current-tiled controls work in runtime paths
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure smoke only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if current-tiled control does not preserve observation shape
stop if vector env reset/step does not apply current-tiled transform
stop if reset_hidden_policy is not honored by evaluation policy
stop if smoke requires private holdout or training
fallback_plan: route to runtime implementation repair if current-tiled smoke fails
route to evaluator repair if reset-policy smoke fails
route to corrected pilot design if smoke passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1203 implementation needs no-training runtime smoke before corrected pilot rerun

blocked_shortcuts: do not make performance or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: corrected pilot design or implementation repair is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1204 tests controls that will later isolate current-frame substitution; smoke itself is not self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If smoke fails, route to implementation repair and do not run corrected pilot.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Corrected reset and current-tiled controls work in no-training runtime/eval paths.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next corrected pilot or repair milestone is selected
failure_criteria: smoke treats runtime checks as performance evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
decision_rule: M1204 passes if no-training runtime smoke proves corrected controls work without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion.
